scorecard.venue: Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, Lucknow

batting.name: KL Rahul
batting.dismissal: c TA Boult b Avesh Khan

batting.name: DJ Hooda
batting.dismissal: c R Powell b R Ashwin

batting.name: N Pooran
batting.dismissal: c TA Boult b Sandeep Sharma

batting.name: YBK Jaiswal
batting.dismissal: c Ravi Bishnoi b MP Stoinis

batting.name: R Parag
batting.dismissal: c A Badoni b A Mishra

balls.text: low full toss on leg stump. Krunal gives himself room and drills it towards long on. A slight fumble by Powell, and the batters can get back for two. Krunal is walking back up the stairs very gingerly and seemed to be holding the back of his thigh. LSG will hope that is nothing serious
off-pace and into the track outside off. Badoni shuffles across and slaps it towards long off
tucks up Krunal for room with a length ball outside leg. He shanks it behind square for just a single

gets the yorker right on this occasion. Krunal digs it out towards long on. Krunal always wanted two but Badoni initially sent him back. Powell, though, misfielded and then just looked at the batters, who, after having a mid-pitch conversation, decided to go back for the second
low full toss on middle and leg. Krunal swings at it with all his might and clinks it towards long on for a brace
boundary off the first ball! Slower bumper outside leg. Krunal picks it early enough and hooks it over the fielder at short fine leg!
full on middle and off. Badoni brings his wrists into play and flicks it towards deep mid wicket. Just six off the penultimate over!
very full and zoning in on the stump. Krunal jams it back at the bowler, who cannot collect cleanly. Rolls away towards long off
slower bumper on middle and off. Badoni walks across his stumps and swipes it on the bounce to long leg

short well outside off. Badoni lets it go and the umpire calls it a wide. RR are not happy with that call and review it. Seemed to be beyond the tramlines but the question is whether Badoni moved and if he did, by how much. The third umpire says the ball is beyond the tramlines and that the wide call should stand.

right up in the blockhole. Follows the batter outside leg too and Krunal can only jam it to the left of the pitch. Boult picks it up, fires a throw at the bowler's end but misses. Had he hit the stumps, Krunal would have been on his way
short and wide outside off. Krunal throws the kitchen sink at it but only swishes at thin air
excellent yorker on middle and leg. Krunal can only squeeze it back to the bowler. Boult rushes back, probably to ensure RR complete their overs on time
another top yorker just outside leg. Krunal flicks it to long on and retains strike
nails the wide yorker again. Badoni tries to paddle it into the leg side, having walked across, but misses it completely. Pings off the boot towards backward point
short and wide outside off. Badoni sits deep in his crease and cuts it towards deep backward point. Boult misfields and ends up conceding the second
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Krunal clears his front leg and drills it down the ground to long off

holes out to deep backward point! Short, wide and asking Rahul to hit to the bigger side. He throws the kitchen sink at it but never seemed to get the power to clear that massive boundary. Slices it towards Boult on the deep backward point fence, and the Kiwi makes no mistake. Rahul is gutted with the way he has gotten out. RR, meanwhile, will be chuffed with how they have been chipping away!
gets the wide yorker right. Rahul digs it out towards deep cover point and hares back for two
shortens his length after seeing Badoni advance. He does not get to the pitch and in trying to stab it, jams it off the inside edge into his pads
on a length on off. Rahul skips down the track and flicks it towards deep mid wicket
full on off. Badoni brings out the sweep and hits it on the bounce to deep backward square leg
shot! Another carrom ball, fired in at 95.6kph. This is full, though, and that allows Badoni to nail the reverse. Lifts it over backward point for four!
bac of a length on middle and leg. Badoni goes back and uses the big ground dimensions to his advantage again. Places it behind square and bags a brace
back of a length on off. Badoni, having gotten down on one knee, bunts it into the mid wicket region and has enough time to pick up two
oh dear! Carrom ball goes wrong and Ashwin sprays this down leg. Badoni does not make contact and Samson cannot get anything behind it either
length ball way outside off. Badoni walks across his stumps considerably and paddles it towards backward square leg
back of a length outside off. Rahul goes back and chops it towards backward point
short and too wide outside off. Left alone by Rahul and called a wide by the umpire
another cutter, this time on a length on the pads. Badoni glances it behind square for a single
leg-cutter on a length outside off. Rahul lets the ball come to him and jabs it towards deep cover point
full on middle and leg. Badoni comes forward and tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg

Sandeep outfoxes Pooran! Dug into the track on middle and leg. Pooran tries to swipe this over deep backward square leg but the ball gets big on him. Cannot control his stroke and the ball skews off the top edge towards Boult, who keeps his eyes on the ball and takes the catch well inside the fence. Pooran is disappointed, but this is just what RR would have wanted after the time-out!
finishes the over with a boundary! Slow and short outside off. Sits up to be hit and Rahul belts it between deep mid wicket and long on!
full toss outside off. Pooran clears his front leg and hacks it down the ground to long off
low full toss outside off. Rahul gives himself room and drills it out to deep cover point
banged in short outside off. Too short, though, and it balloons over Rahul's head. Called a wide for height
nails the wide yorker outside off. Pooran opens his bat face and guides it towards deep backward point
slow and into the track on middle and leg. Pooran has a swipe across the line but is too early into the stroke. Cops a blow on the body for his troubles
off-pace on a hard length on middle and leg. Rahul tries to stay leg side and stabs it into the off side
short and wide outside off. Rahul gets onto the back foot and cuts it towards deep cover
back of a length just outside off. Pooran stays back and punches it to long off
slightly slower on a length on leg stump. Pooran gets down on one knee and helps it towards deep backward square leg. Chahal wanted Ashwin to dive at short fine leg but Ashwin did not do so
slider on a length just outside off. Pooran presses half forward and taps it gently towards extra cover
fired in full on off. Rahul eases it down the ground to long off
fullish on middle and off. Pooran comes forward and pushes it towards extra cover
slanted in on a length on the pads. Rahul bunts it and places it perfectly. Barely crosses the ring in the mid wicket region and he can canter back for two
tossed up full and wide outside off. Pooran reaches out for it and drives it towards deep cover point
off the mark! Shortish just outside off. Pooran makes room for himself and throws his hands at it, slashing it past slip for four. Ashwin bowled this from well behind the stumps too
fuller outside off. Rahul comes forward and jabs it towards deep cover point
slowed up on a length on leg stump. Pooran plays all over it and the ball pings off the thigh pad behind square on the leg side

Ashwin gets Hooda! Carrom ball on a length on middle and leg. Hooda advances, trying to smash it over long on. Does not quite get to the pitch, though, and has to reach out in front. Chalks it off the toe-end and Powell circles under it at long on to complete the catch. Vital wicket for the Royals, but take nothing away from the excellent hand Hooda has played here!
shot! Floated up into the slot just outside off. Rahul plants his front foot and blasts it back past the bowler for four. Might have nutmegged Chahal too!
on a length but way outside off. Left alone by Rahul and called a wide
full and wide outside off again. Hooda drives it towards deep cover point and gets to his fifty - off just 30 balls!
very full on leg stump. Rahul backs away and tugs it down the ground towards long on
length well outside off. Rahul stretches for it and jabs it towards deep cover point for a brace
low full toss on the stumps. Hooda eases it down the ground towards long on
more exquisite batting!
back of a length on middle and off. Hooda stands tall and punches it to long off
four more, this is awesome batting! Shortish just outside off. Hooda rises with the bounce and caresses it past backward point!
supreme timing! Fractionally short on off. Hooda gives himself room early, focusses on timing it and does so superbly, beating extra cover and mid off!
short ball, slanting into leg stump. Hooda drops it into the backward point region and senses there is an opportunity for the second. Has to scramble back and makes it
five wides! Banged into the track, attempting to follow Hooda outside leg. This is too short, though, and it sails over the batter's head. Beats Samson too, and LSG get five extras!
hard length just outside off. Comes back in with the angle and cramps Rahul for room. He stabs it into the off side
slow and short outside off. Hooda hops up onto his toes and dabs it towards deep backward point
given a bit of air outside off. Hooda skips down the track and drills it towards long on
fuller on middle and off. Rahul pokes it enough to extra cover's left and moves on to 52
gets to fifty in style! Marginally short on middle and off. Rahul picks the length early, sits back and hammers it between long on and deep mid wicket!
fullish just outside off. Hooda gets forward and punches it to extra cover's right for a single
full just outside off. Hooda gets down on one knee and sweeps it powerfully towards deep square leg, where Sandeep makes up ground to his left and cuts it off
lovely! Floated up full on off. Hooda gives himself room, uses his reach and lofts it inside-out over extra cover!
on a length on middle and off. Hooda advances and works it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Rahul pushes it towards extra cover and sprints across to the other end
darted down leg. Rahul lets it go and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide. Ashwin bowled that from way behind the stumps
full on leg again. Hooda gets forward and drives it to long on
angled in full on leg stump. Hooda prods it back towards the bowler
back of a length outside off. Rahul hops back and cuts it towards deep point
back of a length on middle and leg. Hooda stays back and eases it to long on
leg-cutter on a back of a length on off. Rahul bunts it right between the sweepers at deep mid wicket and long on, and bags a brace
four more! Full toss outside off. Rahul opens up his stance and swings at it with all his might. Does not middle it but manages to muscle it between deep mid wicket and long on!
oh dear! Wild waist-high full toss at Rahul's body. He keeps his eyes on it all the way, though, and just helps it over the fine leg fence. Called a No ball too...
hard length on middle and off. Rahul stays back and nudges it into the open spaces in the mid wicket region. Saunters back for two
shorter and wider outside off. Skids off the surface and Rahul, trying to dab it fine, is late on the stroke
high and handsome! Length on off, and that is into Rahul's arc. Picks the line and the length early, plants his front foot and whips it over deep mid wicket!
length just outside off. Rahul presses half forward and taps it towards extra cover
slightly quicker, bowled at 90.9kph on a full length just outside off. Hooda backs away and drives it straight to extra cover
slower and loopier on a length on the pads. Hooda lunges forward and eases it between long on and dee mid wicket. Has enough time to get back for two
shorter on middle and off. Rahul gives himself room and jabs it out to deep cover point

nicely done! Length on middle and leg. Rahul gets down on one knee, rolls his wrists over it and sweeps it neatly behind square. Boult put in the dive, running to his right from deep square leg but could not save the boundary!
flighted up fuller on middle and off. Hooda gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it towards long off
length just outside off. Holds in the surface just a bit and Hooda plays it back to Chahal
glorious! Half-volley just outside off and Rahul takes full toll. Gets his hands through the ball and caresses it between extra cover and mid off!
another full toss, although this is outside off. Hooda knocks it to long on
shot! Gentle low full toss on the pads. Hooda lines it up and lifts it comfortably over mid wicket for four!
off-pace on a back of a length on leg stump. Rahul, having backed away, pushes it towards long on
another low full toss, this time on leg stump. Rahul pokes it towards mid wicket. Hooda wanted the single but Rahul was not interested
oh my, how has that missed off stump?! Low full toss just outside off. Rahul moves across early, trying to sweep it. Misses it completely and the ball goes between his body and the stumps
four to end the over! Short and wide outside off. Might have been the ball that is designed to shape away. Hooda throws his hands at it and slashes it fine past the keeper!
short outside off. Rahul goes back and punches it towards extra cover

how has he gotten that there?! Darted in on leg stump. Ends up as a full toss but that nearly outwitted Rahul, who seemed to have pre-meditated the sweep. Fell over as he made contact but got it well over the fielder at short fine leg!
dropped shorter outside off, perhaps expecting Rahul to advance. Jabbed out to extra cover
fired in on a full length outside off. Seems to drift away late and that causes Rahul to get a leading edge on his attempted flick
on a length on middle and off. Hooda presses forward and knocks it to long on
hard length outside off. Zips back in and Rahul, looking to dab it away, is beaten for pace

back of a length outside off. Hooda stands up on his toes and punches through the line. Bisects cover point and extra cover but the ball does not have enough legs to reach the fence. Hooda gets three for his toil
full just outside off. Rahul pushes it towards cover and picks up another single
hard length outside off. A hint of nip back in and Hooda stabs it to mid on for a single
shortish outside off. Hooda tries to force it through the off side but ends up chopping it towards backward point
back of a length just outside off. Rahul uses the pace and runs it down to third man
oh! Length in the channel just outside off. Does not swing back in and goes on with the angle instead. Hooda plays for the original line and is beaten on the outside
fuller just outside off. Hooda gets onto the front foot and pokes it towards extra cover
shot! Length outside off. Hooda gets on top of the bounce and drives it on the up off the front foot. Beats extra cover and Avesh at mid off
length on middle and off. Rahul presses half forward and tips it to mid off. Hares across to the other end and makes it comfortably
more swing, very full on off. Rahul accounts for it and pushes it down the ground towards mid off
finds the fence! Boult goes for the in-swinging yorker on middle and leg. Rahul gauges it just in time, brings his bat through and flicks it to Chahal's right at mid on!

middle stump has been flattened now! RR all over LSG in the powerplay! Full ball that starts on off and swerves back in. Stoinis, without really getting to the pitch of the ball, tries to drive it. Leaves a gap between bat and pad, and the ball zips through. Stoinis might have gotten an inside edge but it does not matter in the grander scheme of things. LSG two down, and under the pump!
full just outside off. Rahul comes forward confidently and drives it towards long on
back of a length outside off. Rahul gets a stride in and punches it towards extra cover
length on middle and off. Rahul comes half forward and defends
more swing but this drifts onto the pads. Rahul uses the shape and glances it behind square for a couple of runs
a bit of in-swing, on a length just outside off. Stops in the surface too as Rahul plonks it to mid off
length on the pads. Stoinis lets the ball come to him before helping it towards square leg
back of a length on the stumps. Stoinis gets behind the line and plays with a straight bat

huge appeal, not given! Full and shaping into middle and leg. Stoinis is caught on the crease and plays al over it. Gets pinged on the pads but that was perhaps doing too much. RR do not review either. Had RR reviewed, it would have come back as 'Umpire's Call' on the 'Wickets' parameter

hot knife through butter, and off stump has been flattened! Back of a length on off. Seems to pitch and nip back in just a shade. de Kock tries to defend but his bat comes down at an angle. He is late on the stroke too and the ball breezes past the willow before leaving off stump in a mess. Another first-over wicket for Boult!
back to back boundaries for de Kock! Over-compensates and bowls it full on the pads. de Kock is just waiting for it and clips it past mid wicket!

edged and four! Fullish outside off and this curves away devilishly. Does so late too and de Kock is drawn into a poke. Gets a thick outside edge that flies past second slip and into the third man fence!

there it is! The coup de grâce landed by the RR skipper, and it is a shot befitting of a classy knock! Low full toss speared into middle and leg. Samson walks across his stumps nonchalantly and whips it away over the fine leg fence. What a run-chase this has been, and the exclamation mark was just as impressive as what preceded it!
Samson is making it look so easy! Shortish on off. Samson picks up the length and reads it like the morning daily. Opens up his stance and smears it over mid wicket!
full toss on middle and leg. Jurel is a little late on the stroke and hoicks it behind square on the leg side
slower ball into the track outside off. Jurel hacks at it and chalks it off the toe-end towards mid wicket
into the blockhole on middle and off. Samson opens his bat face and steers it down to third man
banged into the track outside off. Jurel steps across, gets on top of the bounce and pulls it towards deep square leg

second six of the over, and the LSG shoulders are beginning to drop! Slower ball on a back of a length on leg stump. Does not grip in the surface and instead, sits up. Samson gets inside the line and wallops it over deep backward square leg!
maiden IPL fifty for Jurel! Yorker just outside off. Jurel digs it out towards extra cover and salutes to the dressing room as they applaud his effort. A top innings in tough circumstances!
very full on the stumps. Samson brings his bat down in time and tucks it towards deep mid wicket
insult to injury! Half-tracker outside off and Samson, after rubbing his eyes at what has been dished out, deposits it ten rows back over deep mid wicket! Brings up his fifty too!

dreadful mix-up but Mohsin has botched up a run-out chance! Slow and short outside off. Samson has no pace to work with and guides it on the bounce to short third. Jurel wanted the single but Samson did not. Both of them have a mid-pitch discussion. Thakur gets it over to Mohsin. The throw is not great but Mohsin does not gather at all. Has two or three goes at it and by that time, Jurel gets back!
back of a length outside off. Samson frees his arms and laces his drive on the up. Stoinis has to sprawl to his left at long off and does just enough to prevent the boundary
another bouncer, on middle and off. Samson gets into an awkward tangle but manages to pull it all along the carpet towards deep square leg
slower bumper outside off. Jurel gets on top of the bounce and pulls it towards deep square leg
full toss on off again. Jurel transfers his weight forward and clips it towards long on. Hooda sprints to his right, puts in the dive and saves two
that has flown to the fence like a tracer bullet! Banged in short but it does not get up very high. Up to the chest and Jurel swivels nicely, clattering it past deep square leg!
off-pace and dug into the track outside off. Jurel waits an eternity for it before dabbing it towards short third man
low full toss on off. Jurel tugs it down the ground towards long on. The fielding is a little lax and Samson can race back for the second

Jonty Rhodes takes the catch, but he is stood beyond the boundary! Six to finish the over! Half-tracker on middle and leg. Samson's eyes light up and he whacks it flat over deep mid wicket. Neat catch by the LSG fielding coach, but unfortunately for them, it will not count!
fullish well outside off. Samson tries to smash it into tomorrow but ends up shanking it back to the bowler
back to back boundaries for Samson! Bishnoi over-compensates and bowls a low full toss outside off. Samson gets under it and dispatches it disdainfully to long off's left!
hits the gap, and picks up another boundary! Back of a length on leg. Samson opens up his front hip and mows it past deep mid wicket!
zipped in full on middle and leg. Jurel clears his front leg and heaves it towards deep mid wicket
what has happened here?! Shortish on leg stump. Samson swings so hard at it that he loses control of tehe bat. The bat goes towards short fine, and the ball bobbles out to deep backward square leg
shorter outside off, perhaps because Krunal saw Jurel advancing. Jurel, though, is smart enough to bunt it into the open spaces in the mid wicket region and bags two
darted in on a length on leg stump. Jurel plays all over it and gets struck on the thigh pad
back of a length on off. Samson pushes it towards long off and is content with a single
what a shot! Slants it in full on leg stump. Samson, rather than going leg side, shapes up for the reverse and nails it, clearing point comfortably!
angled in on a back of a length just outside off. Jurel stabs it down the ground to long off
fired in on a length on leg stump. Samson advances and jabs it out towards deep cover

dropped again, although this was much more difficult! Proper Test match line and length. In the channel and that forces Jurel to poke at it. Gets a healthy outside nick that flies to Thakur's left at short third. He dives, thrusts out his left hand but can only parry it into the fence!
back of a length outside off. Samson hangs back in his crease and punches it towards deep cover

palmed over the bar! Full and angled across the batter outside off. Jurel opens his bat face and glides it towards short third, where Thakur shells it. Jonty Rhodes will not be happy with that effort...
another boundary! Mohsin is bleeding runs! Off-pace and into the track on middle and off. Sits up, though, and Jurel pounds it past deep mid wicket!
wow, what innovation! Mohsin goes full outside off but Jurel has a riposte ready. Shuffles across, gets down low and scoops it over the keeper's head!
splits the fielders! Half-tracker outside off and it gets the treatment it deserves. Jurel gets on top of the bounce and scythes it between deep cover point and deep backward point!
darted in on a length on leg. Jurel advances and works it towards deep mid wicket
angled in on a back of a length on middle and leg. Jurel plays all over it and gets pinged on the back leg
short ball on the pads. Samson hops back and swings it away towards deep backward square leg
fired in again, on a length just outside off. Jurel stabs it to long on
slows it up on middle and off. Samson advances, trying to go inside out. Only manages to jam it off the inside edge into his pads
back of a length on off. Jurel knocks it down the ground to long on
shot! Short, wide and that is begging to be hit. Samson obliges by standing up on his toes and slapping it to long off's left!
full and wide outside off again. Samson thinks about swishing at it before pulling out at the last moment. More exercise for the umpire
slower ball but bowled well outside off. Beyond the tramlines too and called a wide

gets this right out of the middle! Second juicy full toss Samson has been served up this over, and this time, Samson does not miss out. Stays deep in his crease and bashes it past the bowler. The umpire did well to get out of the way too!
another attempted yorker that ends up as a low full toss outside off. Jurel jams it towards mid off for a single
beautiful! Wide half-volley and Jurel pounces. Bends his back knee to generate elevation and cracks it over extra cover for four!
full toss outside off and Thakur gets away with this. Samson, in trying to hit it too hard, scuffs it to long off
low full toss outside off. Jurel opens his bat face and guides it down to deep backward point
floated up very full outside off. Samson digs it out towards extra cover
four more! Short down leg and that is a freebie. Samson, by the time he makes contact, has his back to the bowler and taps it on its head, beating short fine leg to his right!
slower on a length on off. Jurel goes back and eases it out to long on
pushed through quicker on a length on middle and off. Jurel is caught on the crease and prods it back to the bowler
Jurel lands his first punch! Given a bit of air outside off. Jurel dances down the track in a flash and dumps it over long on!
googly on a back of a length on off. Samson reads it off the pitch and cuts it towards deep cover point
back of a length on middle and off. Samson stays back and punches it towards long on
length on middle and off. Jurel presses half forward and knocks it to long on to get off the mark
full outside off. Jurel comes forward and pushes it towards short extra cover
full on middle and off. Jurel plays it back to the bowler
darted in on a length on middle and off. Bowled at 99.3kph and Jurel pokes it back to the bowler
fizzed through on a fullish length on middle and off. Straightens a touch and takes the leading edge as Samson tries to work to leg. Bobbles past extra cover for one
plenty of loop, on a full length outside off. Driven straight to short extra cover
tossed up on a length outside off. Jurel lunges forward and defends

Mishra gets rid of Parag, and he points to the back of his shirt in celebration! What theatre! Dangles the carrot outside off and Parag bites. He thinks he can go inside out but this is a slider that seems to just hurry onto him a touch. Slices it and Badoni makes no mistake at deep cover. Mishra is elated, and LSG are now right back in this!
Parag goes big! Long-hop outside off and Parag cashes in. Uses the depth of the crease, opens up his stance and launches it over long on!
back of a length just outside off. Samson hangs back and eases it to long off
slider on a back of a length on off. Parag stabs it down the ground to long on
darted in on leg stump again. Parag comes forward and nudges it towards deep mid wicket
full outside off. Samson gets onto the front foot and drives it to long off
length on middle and leg. Parag presses half forward and knocks it to long on
back of a length on leg. Samson goes back and punches it towards deep mid wicket
slanted into the pads again. Parag eases it out towards deep mid wicket
fired in full on the pads. Parag uses the pace and works it enough to deep backward square leg's left to come back for two
hard length just outside off. Parag hops up onto his toes and punches it to long on
back of a length just outside off. Sticks in the surface a little as Parag plonks it back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and leg. Samson tucks it off his hips towards deep mid wicket
full on the pads. Parag comes forward and flicks it to long on to get off the mark
back of a length on middle and off. Seems to nip away a shade and that squares up Parag as he defends

Jaiswal bites the dust now! LSG go bang-bang! Back of a length delivery angled across the batter outside off. Jaiswal winds up and has a huge swish at it. Slices across it too much, though, and finds the sweeper on the deep cover fence. Stoinis is delighted; Jaiswal, not quite!
hard length on middle and leg. Samson is cramped for room and is content to defend

Yash Thakur has the last laugh! Zips in a low full toss on leg stump. Buttler, having walked across his stumps, almost cuts himself off by how far he has moved. Cannot lay bat on ball, and hears the death rattle soon after. Sees the image of his leg stump flattened too, and he is absolutely livid with himself. Thakur will not mind one bit, though, and he has given LSG the breakthrough they were after!
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Jaiswal tucks it towards mid wicket
short, wide and put away! Too much width and Jaiswal will feast on that all day long. Throws the plumbing at it and flays it over point!
hard length just outside off. Buttler works it to mid on's right and gets across to the other end
another first-ball boundary for Buttler, this has now become a happy habit! Speared in full on the pads. Buttler just uses the pace and the angle to clip it through square leg!
another short ball outside off. Buttler rolls his wrists over it and helps it towards deep square leg
shot! Dug into the track outside off but this sits up to be hit. Buttler rocks back and pummels it just behind square for four!

well well! Spears it full outside off after seeing Jaiswal shape up for the scoop. He has to change his shot mid-way and tries to reverse lap it. Makes no contact and the ball pings off the pads into the off side
fullish just outside off. Jaiswal clears his front leg and has a wild mow across the line. Only swats away a few flies in the process
back of a length just outside off. Buttler gets up on his toes and punches it uppishly. Well past extra cover, though, and he has enough time to get back for three
another first-ball boundary! Right up in the slot outside off. Buttler manages to get under it and muscles it over mid on. One bounce and into the fence!
goes short and follows the batter way outside leg. Jaiswal has to take evasive action in the end and then looks at the umpire quizzically, hoping for the wide. Gets no favours, though
off-pace and dug into the track outside off. Buttler swipes at it but is early into the stroke. Squirts off the inside edge towards deep square leg
back of a length on off. Jaiswal gets behind the line and pats it towards mid off for a single
back of a length outside off. Buttler steps down the track and turns it into the mid wicket region
back of a length outside off. Buttler rises with the bounce and punches it crisply past cover point for a couple of runs
boundary off the first ball of the over! Over-pitched just outside off. Buttler plants his front foot and smacks it back past the bowler!
back of a length on leg stump. Buttler gets up on his toes and tucks it off his hips towards deep square leg
full on middle and off. Buttler is caught on the crease this time and prods it back to the bowler
Jos Buttler special! Angled in on a length just outside off. Buttler picks the line very early, shuffles across and laps it clean over the keeper's head!
shorter outside off. Jaiswal gets onto the back foot and cuts it towards deep point
back of a length just outside off. Jaiswal goes feeling for it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge. Might have jagged away off the surface too
length just outside off. Jaiswal stands up tall and punches it towards mid off
beauty! Length in the channel. Nips away with the angle and breezes past the outside edge as Buttler wafts at it
back of a length on the pads. Buttler lets the ball come to him before glancing it behind square for a brace
length on middle and off. Buttler presses half forward and defends
back of a length just outside off. Jaiswal punches it off the back foot towards cover point, where de Kock dives sharply to his right and keeps it to one
streaky! Back of a length in the channel just outside off. Straightens against the angle and squares up Jaiswal. He nibbles at it and gets a thick outside edge that races away past third man!
length just outside off. Jaiswal tries to go inside out but only manages to scuff it towards extra cover
banged in short outside off. Jaiswal hops up onto his toes and cuts it towards deep backward point
shot! Another fullish ball outside off. There is width on offer too and Jaiswal goes through the line, banging it over mid off!
right out of the screws! In the arc outside off, and Jaiswal hits it out of the park. Plants his front foot, swings through the line and clubs it over long on!
hard length just outside off. Jaiswal tries to hit it too hard and shanks it back to the bowler
peach! Back of a length just outside off. Decks back sharply and cuts Buttler in half. Too hot to handle for Rahul too and he concedes a bye
back of a length just outside off. Jaiswal jabs it towards cover and calls for the single. The throw at the bowler's end by Gowtham is wild and considerably off the mark
